# xfetch-cli context

> Developer and AI context for the xfetch ecosystem. Documentation only; the
> source repositories are separate clones under ~/repos/xfetch-cli/.

## Repositories

- xfetch: https://github.com/xfetch-cli/xfetch (core binary, probes, UI, addon runtime)
- api: https://github.com/xfetch-cli/api (SDK crates, JSON protocols, WIT)
- plugins: https://github.com/xfetch-cli/plugins (official plugins)
- effects: https://github.com/xfetch-cli/effects (intro effects)
- extensions: https://github.com/xfetch-cli/extensions (config providers)
- web: https://github.com/xfetch-cli/web (landing and docs)
- configs: https://github.com/xfetch-cli/configs (presets)
- themes: https://github.com/xfetch-cli/themes (theme registry)
- logos: https://github.com/xfetch-cli/logos (ASCII art catalog)
- assets: https://github.com/xfetch-cli/assets (brand assets)
- homebrew-tap: https://github.com/xfetch-cli/homebrew-tap (macOS formula)
- .github: https://github.com/xfetch-cli/.github (org profile)

## Key documents

- README.md: map and entrypoint
- ecosystem.md: architecture, wire protocols, catalogs, version matrix
- repositories.md: local paths, remotes, branches, authoritative sources
- workflows.md: end-to-end task recipes
- conventions.md: versioning, naming, security, CI invariants
- current-state.md: branches, PRs, releases and pending work
- future-roadmap.md: v1.0.3, crates.io, JSON output and CI plans
- crates-io/README.md: publishing context
- AGENTS.md: operating rules for coding agents
- resources/: agent roles and task skills

## Current invariants

- JSON addon protocol: 1
- WIT package: xfetch:runtime@0.1.0
- Manifest schema: 1
- Catalog schema: 1
- Plugins add info, effects transform output, extensions mutate config
- Published crates.io versions are immutable
- Use ~/repos/xfetch-cli/<repo> in commands
